{{Top|leg}}
'''Duracord''' was a strengthened fiber [[Rope/Legends|rope]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|215|duracord}}</ref> Duracord was used in the construction of [[Stun net/Legends|stun nets]], where it was covered in a conductive liquid adhesive and had [[stun bead]]s and [[stun thread]]s woven into it to conduct electrical shock charges.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
